subject.title: Feature: configurable LLM retry with backoff on transient errors (overloaded/529)

question: What permanent public retry contract should OpenClaw expose for main LLM requests: provider-level, agent/global, both, or no new config surface?
rationale: The request adds public configuration and changes provider/fallback runtime behavior, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive and product-owned.

options.title: Settle provider-level retry first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98110 as the API direction only after maintainers approve the contract and require runtime wiring before closing this issue.

options.title: Design agent/global retry
options.body: Specify an agents.defaults-style policy with retry classes, backoff array, total cap, and notification semantics before implementation.

options.title: Reject new retry config
options.body: Keep only existing failover, cooldown, provider operation retry, and cron retry paths, then close the feature direction after an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Settle provider-level retry first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98110 as the API direction only after maintainers approve the contract and require runtime wiring before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history across the adjacent retry/failover and provider request config surfaces.
